blocks.text: 🪝 Cotton Corporation of India Launches 'Kapas Darshan' Bulletin & ₹5,659 Cr Kapas Kanti Mission. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Transfers ₹41,530 crore directly to cotton farmers under record MSP procurement operations.
MSP Procurement: CCI procured 522 lakh quintals of seed cotton (kapas) via 24 lakh transactions, transferring ₹41,530 crore directly to bank accounts.
Kapas Kanti Mission: Cotton Productivity Mission approved with ₹5,659 crore outlay over 5 years.
